thread:
Ava: flagging intermittent funcall parse failures on int4-canary-2. rate ~0.9% since 02:30 UTC.
Diego: any sample outputs?
Ava: here's one (redacted):
```
{"tool":"lookup_user","args":{"email":"foo@example.com"}}

[TRACE id=abc123 kernel:quantized_write_bytes]

{"tool":"open_ticket","args":{"title":"db timeout"}}
```
Ava: note the trace line inserted between two JSON lines. decoder treats whole payload as NDJSON and fails on the trace line.
Kira: that looks like a logging marker leaked into stdout. which layer emits [TRACE]?
Sam: likely the quant runtime's debug macro; we accidentally left a logging shim enabled for canary builds when running with streaming on.
Diego: can reproduce locally when enabling streaming+batch_split=auto+int4-profile=aggressive.
Kira: timeline: we rolled int4-canary-2 for throughput improvement yesterday; float canary had no issues.
Ava: impact: funcall compliance test suite shows increased flakiness for NDJSON consumers (clients expecting consecutive JSON objects).
Sam: mitigation options:
- short term: strip any non-JSON lines in the parser-rescue path (whitelist lines that start with "{" or "[")
- medium term: remove debug trace emission from runtime in quant path and add integration test to catch stdout pollution
- fallback: route traffic to int8-canary or fp16 until fix
Diego: infra-bot, can you toggle canary to int8 and disable int4 rollout?
infra-bot: Deploy 4292004330: canary route update -> model=int8-canary-1 initiated by @Diego
Kira: also adding a small harness: run funcall-eval that pipes model stdout to a sanitizer and fails build if any non-json lines detected for 1000 sample runs.
Ava: agree. Diego, can you collect raw stdout for 50 failing invocations and attach? will help find which component prints the marker.
Diego: on it, will upload in ~30m.
Sam: note: we should treat this as a quality regression and add a regression alert: any NDJSON parse failures >0.2% for new quant artifacts.
Kira: making a gist with the sanitizer snippet for quick PR merge:
```python
# naive sanitizer
for line in stdout.splitlines():
    if line.strip() == "":
        continue
    if not (line.lstrip().startswith('{') or line.lstrip().startswith('[')):
        raise ValueError('non-json line in model output: ' + repr(line))
```
Sam: sounds good. Ava, can you own communication to support teams in case customers hit it?
Ava: yup, short note drafted. will post to #support-alerts if we see customer hits.
Diego: uploaded traces to the bucket: s3://redwood-canary/traces/int4-interleaved-2026-03-21.tar.gz
Ava: thanks. will follow up after Diego's dumps. :thumbsup:
